(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (apply-command grid cmd)
      (cond [(= cmd 1) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= cmd 2) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= cmd 3) (flip-lr grid)]
            [else (transpose grid)]))
    (apply-command (crop-to-content (set-cell g 0 0 0)) (at g 0 0))))
